MOD = 10**9 + 7

def sum_of_partition_weights(n, k, weights):
    # Precompute factorials and their modular inverses
    fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    inv_fact = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(2, n + 1):
        fact[i] = fact[i - 1] * i % MOD
        inv_fact[i] = pow(fact[i], MOD - 2, MOD)

    # Precompute powers of 2 modulo MOD
    power_of_2 = [1] * (n + 1)
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        power_of_2[i] = power_of_2[i - 1] * 2 % MOD

    # dp[i][j] will store the sum of weights of all partitions of i elements into j subsets
    dp = [[0] * (k + 1) for _ in range(n + 1)]
    dp[0][0] = 1

    # Iterate over the number of elements
    for i in range(1, n + 1):
        # Iterate over the number of subsets
        for j in range(1, min(i, k) + 1):
            # Calculate the contribution of the current element to the sum of weights
            dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] * weights[i - 1] % MOD
            for l in range(1, i):
                dp[i][j] += dp[l][j] * dp[i - l][j] * power_of_2[i - l] % MOD
                dp[i][j] %= MOD

    return dp[n][k]
